parole.testo: From Middle High German marc (“half-pound”), from Proto-Germanic *marką (“mark, sign”). As a German currency, a calque of German Mark. As a Finnish currency, a calque of Finnish markka, via Old Swedish mark. Cognate with English mark, Catalan marc, and Galician and Spanish marco.
